notes.title: Price Adjustments!
notes.content:
We would like to inform you about a price change of Wolf Attack in the Steam Store. Effective [b]30. September 2021(PST).[/b]

The price before the adjustment for this game was €16,99, £14.99, $19.99 Following the adjustments, the new price will be €8,99, £7,99, $9,99, beginning from 30.September.

These adjustments were made due to the fact that the Oculus support is delayed to an inaccurate time, and we still want to make the price more attractive to new players. 

We wanted to inform you of these adjustments as soon as possible for your convenience. 
We appreciate your support and look forward to providing a satisfying game experience and service in the future.

Yours Sincerely,
TomatoVR
